purpose.zh: 练肩膀里面的小肌肉，让肩膀更结实
purpose.en: Builds the small muscles deep in your shoulder so it feels sturdier.

text.zh: 手肘贴着身子，小臂往上往外转
text.en: Elbow at your side, turn your forearm up and out

text.zh: 手肘下面可以垫条毛巾，身子别往后翻。
text.en: Tuck a rolled towel under your elbow. Don't roll back.

text.zh: 转到小臂快朝天就停一下，再慢慢落回肚子前。
text.en: Pause when your forearm points almost straight up, then lower back to your belly.

commonErrors.zh: 转的时候手肘抬离身子
commonErrors.en: Elbow lifting off your side as you turn.

cautions.zh: 肩膀里面夹着疼就转一半，换轻哑铃
cautions.en: If your shoulder pinches inside, turn halfway and use a lighter weight.

cautions.zh: 想加点重量，手里拿瓶水就够
cautions.en: Want more load? A water bottle is enough.

changes: 节奏按真实带练：一下 4.0 s → 3.0 s（转 1.0 / 停 0.5 / 放 1.5）；顶点 < 0.8 s，kind 维持 rep_updown，r2 flag 结束

3 组×每侧12 次，休息 30 秒
